summary: Verification of the verification round's fix pass on the merged head: is each finding the pass took actually fixed, judged from fresh recordings, and did it break anything (the hurt cue at any pitch and the inked rear edge; InsetBlock's new mesh clipping in place of the 2 cm recess, the rooms' clipped boxes and the wider scan; the Kicker's eyes, the Bruiser's helmet and visor and Ox's face lines; the strain ratchet and the guards)

lenses.brief: VERIFY the art findings the fix pass took, then hunt for what it broke. The findings: verify-chars-01 and verify-code-01 (the Kicker's eyes: the merged config was the build FIX-ART-A had rejected; the brim turned to skin and the face read as a blank band), verify-chars-02 (the Bruiser's helmet front band above the visor still took blood), verify-chars-03 (Ox's new face ink: a hairy blot under the nose and a stray comma at the jaw), verify-chars-04 (the Bruiser's stair-stepped scarf outline under the visor). For each, say fixed, partly fixed or not fixed, with the still that shows it. BEFORE is /Users/arachne/repos/beat-em-up-PoC/captures/m6-feedback-verify/<slug>/ (the same acts on d582d21, the head before this pass); AFTER is captures_dir/<slug>/ (the merged head 3e7084e): r_kicker, r_bruiser, r_boss (each 'Look: <label> at 1 m'), dk, dj, dox (each turned 0, 90 and 150 degrees at 1.6 m), lineup, heavies (2.5, 5 and 10 m), damage ('Look: tune damage at 1 m'). The pre-wave look (82bab12) is in /Users/arachne/repos/beat-em-up-PoC/captures/m6-feedback-review/ if you need it. The fixers' own sheets are in /Users/arachne/repos/beat-em-up-PoC/.worktrees/m6-vfix-kicker/captures/fix/ and .worktrees/m6-vfix-heavies/captures/fix/ (read them only to see what they claimed). Check these claims hard: (a) the Kicker (VFIX-KICKER shipped option c1: eyes region z 1.625-1.665 on a NEW skin-class slot 24 `kicker_shade` #8c5f4e, the eyes zone's ink at 0.1/0.22): judge against his concept assets/source/concepts/m6/kicker_c.jpg at 1 m (r_kicker), 1.6 m turned (dk: is the brim's underside cap, not skin, in profile and from behind) and 2.5-5 m (lineup, heavies): closer to the concept than d582d21's pale band, and than 82bab12's look? Is the band's ink 'a little ragged' (the fixer's words) or a scribble or a black bar? In the damage act, does the band under the brim bruise and bleed as skin, and does that look right on what reads as the cap's shadow? (b) the Bruiser (VFIX-HEAVIES): a new region helmet_front moves 64 faces to slot 47 (the no-blood helmet slot); a new visor_fill turns the cream wedge into steel; under_visor is z 1.5-1.575 WITHOUT bisect_z, so a small stair stays on the right of the scarf's top border. Is the helmet one clean dome that matches his jacket purple at 1, 2.5 and 5 m and never bleeds in the damage act, while his face and scarf still do? Is the remaining stair visible at 1 m in normal play, and is it worse or better than d582d21's? The fixer judged the straight bisect version (bru3_head.png) not clearly better and did not ship it because it loosens the stretch ratchets by about 60%: give your own view of that trade. (c) Ox (face_skin zone from z 1.58, ink 0.012/0.04): no blot under the nose and no comma at the jaw at 1 m; the face still reads (nose, mouth, chin) at 2.5 and 5 m; did dropping the zone's lower part lose the jaw line or the beard edge his concept draws (assets/source/concepts/m6/ for his pick, boss C)? (d) the palette atlas was regenerated with slot 24: the Punk, the veteran Punk and the Thug must look exactly as in BEFORE (lineup, heavies); any change there is a finding. Then REGRESSIONS: anything on the three characters that is worse than BEFORE at any distance. Out of scope (left by the lead, don't report): the Bruiser's visor slit taking blood (it's the gap in the helmet), about 1% cloth texels on Ox's skin, Ox's mauve shadow-band patches (the toon ramp on smoothed normals, confirmed last round), the Punk's cap logo blot, the Bruiser's cuff ovals, Ox's sawtooth sleeve. Each finding names the character, the distance, the before and after stills, and the config key or file that fixes it (assets/source/characters/<id>/pipeline.json; assets/source/palette/<id>.json).

VERIFY the world and feel findings the fix pass took, then hunt for what it broke. GEOMETRY: verify-world-01 (the 2 cm InsetBlock recesses left small steps that the edge pass inked as seam lines, dashed and crawling at distance: the catwalk wall, the terrace door pillars, the penthouse side, a street pilaster and a skyline corner; the evidence names tour frames f711, f555, f815, f45 and f305 and their crops; read the finding). VFIX-WORLD replaced the recess with MESH CLIPPING: where two blocks share a plane, one block (`InsetBlock.yields_to`) cuts the shared rectangle out of its own drawn mesh; 97 yields on 89 blocks in street.tscn, roofs.tscn and boss_roof.tscn, written by a solver; the crowd street and the training room now do the same for their boxes as they build (RoomKit.resolve_coplanar). The fixer looked at the 20 tour poses and the level walk only, and never at the rooms in play. Sources: tour ('Look: arena tour', 20 poses, one TOUR line per pose in bot.log), drift ('Look: ground drift', ending with held views of the boss roof gap, the deck and the far deck; measure with python3 -I tools/ground_flicker.py <avi> [log]), rooms ('Look: rooms tour': 6 poses in the crowd street, 4 in the training room, TOUR lines in bot.log). The same acts BEFORE: tour and drift on d582d21 in /Users/arachne/repos/beat-em-up-PoC/captures/m6-feedback-verify/ (with the seam lines) and on 82bab12 in /Users/arachne/repos/beat-em-up-PoC/captures/m6-feedback-review/ (before any inset); rooms on d582d21 in captures/m6-feedback-verify/rooms. (1) The five seam sites: gone, and matching 82bab12? (2) What clipping can break that a recess could not, so look for each: a HOLE (sky, void or a far wall seen through a wall, a wall top, a corner, a parapet, a kerb or a doorway, because a block cut a face its partner does not really cover from that side or that height); a missing face seen from another angle (from a roof looking down at a wall top, from inside a doorway, at a drop edge); a CRACK or a line of sparkling pixels along a cut edge (the clipped mesh's new edges make T-junctions with the neighbour's edges); a shift or jump in the trim texture (brick courses, plinth boards, cornices) or in the shading across a cut (UVs, normals or tangents not carried through the clip); a light or shadow leak at a cut; a surface that flickers or swims (a z-fight the clipping missed). The amplified difference between head and d582d21, and between head and 82bab12, at every tour pose and every rooms pose is the fastest way to find where things changed; then look at each changed spot. (3) The rooms: anything in the crowd street or the training room that changed from d582d21 and is worse (a hole, a crack, a shifted texture, a missing face). (4) The boss roof gap: still fixed (drift and tour pose 17; the fixer measured d1 0.038 against 0.185 before the wave). The ground's mirror move was tried and dropped (verify-world-03 stays as it was; don't re-report it). HURT FEEL: verify-world-02 (the hurt cue's side flipped front for back when looking down past about 30 degrees, as at a stomp) and the lead's rear-hit readability item (a Punk's jab from behind darkened the bottom edge by only about 9 grey levels against 55 for one from the front). VFIX-FEEL measures the bearing on the floor plane from the yaw alone, reads the view without the hit kick, and gives every stroke an ink rim, the bottom edge heavier ink (gain 1.5) and its strokes 1.4x longer, so they rise above the HP panel; blocked hits take none of this. Sources: captures_dir/hurt ('Look: player hurt' and its four variants, including the new 'Look: player hurt looking down': 45 degrees down, a jab from behind, the left and the front), and the REAL hits in captures_dir/passive_six ('Six Punks, passive': no god mode, the player stands passive among the real AI and takes damaging hits from every side; each hit is a bot.log line 'f<frame> Player: <move> <dmg> dmg <tier>', the frame is the movie frame at 60 fps). BEFORE: captures/m6-feedback-verify/hurt and passive_six (d582d21). Check: looking down, behind lights the bottom, left the left, front the top; the four-sided acts are still right; for every real hit you can pin in passive_six, the struck edge is the side the attacker stands on; a hit from behind is now as plain at the moment it lands as one from the front (say how you judged it; the fixer could not reproduce the 9-against-55 figure and judged by eye); the rims and the heavier bottom do not make the burst or a run of hits heavy or nauseating; no red anywhere (SPEC: red is for blood, the rear warning and finishers); blocked hits as light as before. Each finding names the act, the time or still, and the file or tunable that fixes it.

Code, tests and ledgers over the fix pass's diff: git diff d582d21 3e7084e (the four merges m6/vfix-feel, m6/vfix-world, m6/vfix-kicker, m6/vfix-heavies, then the preset). VERIFY: the code side of verify-world-02 (FirstPersonCamera.hit_bearing on the floor plane from the yaw only; HurtOverlay reads FirstPersonCamera.view_transform(), which leaves out the kick and roll; the fixer says 11 new tests fail on d582d21's hit_bearing: put the old function back in a scratch copy and run tests/test_m6_feedback_feel.gd to confirm; does view_transform() only read state; are the edge cases still handled (attacker null, freed, not in the tree, within hurt_bearing_min_m, straight above or below the lens so the floor-plane vector is near zero)); verify-code-01 (the Kicker's eyes region z 1.625-1.665 and zone 1.62-1.675 in assets/source/characters/kicker/pipeline.json, and a test that pins the max z and fails on d582d21's config); verify-code-02 (tests/fixtures/strain/bruiser.json back at 2afbe4d's figures except one row, held.min 0.1489 -> 0.1168: diff it against `git show 2afbe4d:tests/fixtures/strain/bruiser.json`, find why a palette-and-bake change moves mesh strain at all, and whether the one loosened row is logged with its reason); verify-code-03 (ASSETS.md rows for every changed binary: the Kicker GLB, rest GLB and detail mask, palette_atlas.png and punk_veteran_atlas.png with slot 24, the Bruiser GLB, rest GLB and mask, boss_detail.png); verify-code-04 and verify-world-04 (the scan now covers the KitPieces (the Dressing) and holds the rooms to the same area as the level; its new exclusions in steps(): boxes of look `fence` and anything under a Barrier; what could they hide); verify-code-05 (INSET_STEP_M, inset_min and inset_max gone: does any scene, script or test still set them); verify-code-06 (the closure test needs a `func test_` and the pipeline path on a code line; does it fail on a comment-only roll-out file; is _roll_out_file_problem robust to a path in a string on a code line that is itself never called). Then MESH CLIPPING (game/level/kit/mesh_clip.gd, inset_block.gd, room_kit.gd): is triangle clipping against the yield rects correct (winding kept, normals, UVs, tangents and any other array the trim body shader reads (game/fx/trim_body.gdshaderinc) carried through and interpolated right; no degenerate or sliver triangles left; the T-junctions it makes along cut edges, and whether they can crack in the raster); the tolerances kit_coplanar_m (0.004) and kit_clip_standoff_m (0.06) as @export_range tunables in a group, with tuning/default.json matching `godot --headless -s tools/gen_default_preset.gd`; the collider exactly unchanged (tests/test_m6_colliders.gd); the yields_to NodePaths: what happens if a block is renamed or moved (a loud failure in a test, or a silent double draw or a hole); the cross-section yield (roofs CurbEast and boss_roof EntryFenceR) when a section is built alone; is the solver deterministic and current (run `godot --headless res://tools/solve_insets.tscn --quit-after 900` on a scratch copy of the scenes with yields_to removed, as the fixer's request says, and compare its YIELD lines with the yields in the scenes); does tools/apply_yields.py write only what it should; is RoomKit.resolve_coplanar run once after every box exists and deterministic; can steps() and holes() fail (put a 2 cm recess or a wrong yield back in a scratch copy and run tests/test_m6_feedback_ground.gd); the cost: each InsetBlock now builds its own clipped mesh at load instead of sharing the cached one, so measure the extra time to instance mission1.tscn headless (head against d582d21) and the extra mesh memory, and say whether the first-frame or spawn hitch could grow (the frame-time run is the lead's). Also: HurtOverlay.edge_strength(BOTTOM) can now exceed 1.0; is every reader of it safe; the four new feel tunables are in a group with defaults; no number left in a script against the rules (any new const in mesh_clip.gd, inset_block.gd, room_kit.gd, hurt_overlay.gd, the camera); the layer rules (the overlay and the camera only read state); no key printed or written; no Tripo, Gemini or ElevenLabs spend. The merged suite is already run (below): don't rerun the whole suite; run single files with -gselect where you need them.

common_note: State: m6/full-art-audio at 3e7084e (code; later commits are docs), PR #6 open and unmerged. Game-boy played M6 and asked for four fixes (the ground flashing, the GO sting, not feeling the hits he takes, blobby enemies). A FEEDBACK round built them, a review found problems, a fix wave fixed those at d582d21, and a verification round on d582d21 found three mediums and several lows (docs/reviews/M6/findings-verify.json). A fix pass of four Sonnet fixers (VFIX-FEEL, VFIX-WORLD, VFIX-KICKER, VFIX-HEAVIES; calls in docs/milestones/M6-calls/VFIX-*.md) was merged at 3e7084e. This round checks that pass independently: you did not build it, and its fixers' claims are claims. Suite on the merged head: 2055/2055 in 422 s with ART_PUNK_VARIANT_STRAIN=1, 0 SCRIPT/SHADER/ERROR lines. Every run.py --check (bruiser, boss, kicker, thug, punk, dummy), player_run.py --asset player --check, gen_palette.py --check and gen_trim.gd --check said YES after the merge. The lead's look at the fixers' own sheets: the five seam sites match 82bab12; looking down, a hit from behind lights the bottom edge; the Kicker has his brim back with a shaded band under it; the Bruiser's helmet is one dome with a small stair left under the visor; Ox has no blot. Fresh recordings on 3e7084e are in captures_dir, one folder per act (bot.avi, bot.log, sheets/; look acts have per-mark stills): r_kicker, r_bruiser, r_boss, dk, dj, dox, lineup, heavies, damage, hurt, passive_six, rooms (crowd bot); tour, drift (level bot on mission1.tscn). The same acts on d582d21 (the BEFORE of this pass) are in /Users/arachne/repos/beat-em-up-PoC/captures/m6-feedback-verify/ (rooms included), and on 82bab12 (before the fix wave) in /Users/arachne/repos/beat-em-up-PoC/captures/m6-feedback-review/. Cut finer stills with ffmpeg from bot.avi when you need a moment. Severity: high = Game-boy would see it in normal play and it undoes one of his four asks; medium = visible at 1-3 m or in a fight, or a rule or test that does not hold; low = everything else. A finding the pass was asked to fix and did not fix is at least the severity it had. Perf is the lead's (measured separately), not a finding. Spec departures already ruled by Game-boy: the victim camera stack and the silent GO (README). Left by the lead, don't report: the ground's mirrored pair (verify-world-03; the fixer's attempt made the ground crawl more), the Bruiser's visor slit taking blood, Ox's mauve shadow-band patches.
